input: Exactly 24 IDs 1–24; integer raw responses 1–7 or explicit null. Reject unknown or duplicate IDs, booleans, nonintegers and out-of-range values.
inputRepresentation: RAW_RESPONSES_1_TO_7; already keyed semantic scores must not be reversed again.
aggregation: Separate means of each four-item facet; no grand total
missing: Conservative policy for this draft: calculate a facet only when all four responses are valid integers 1–7; otherwise report that facet unavailable. Other complete facets may be shown with an incomplete-profile notice. This is a platform proposal, NOT an original author complete-response requirement. No zero filling or imputation.

authorMissingEvidence.reading_fixed_four: Omit missing from sum, divide by all four items. Example [7,7,7,null] gives 21/4=5.25.
authorMissingEvidence.reading_available_count: Omit missing, divide by number of answered items. Same example gives 21/3=7.
authorMissingEvidence.resolution: The wording does not explicitly define the missing-response denominator or minimum answered count. Neither reading is declared definitively the author rule.
authorMissingEvidence.validation_sample_note: Official technical documentation printed page 5, Item analyses, states that the retained validation sample had no missing values after data processing. This does not resolve the scoring denominator ambiguity or establish an author complete-response requirement.

authorMissingQuote: Missings are omitted from the addition procedure. The scale scores consist of mean scores of the subscales which were calculated by dividing the sum score by the number of items in the subscale.
source: https://access.gesis.org/zis/1217, printed page 3 Scoring; original 2020 Appendix recommends separate dimension averages.
